title: Painful Stabs
description: Shuffle 1 Wound into your Discard Pile each time you receive unblocked attack damage.
smart_description: Shuffle [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]{Amount:plural:Wound|Wounds}[/gold] into your Discard Pile each time you receive unblocked attack damage.
notes: This power triggers on the wearer receiving unblocked damage from attacks. For each instance of unblocked damage received, it shuffles Amount wounds into the discard pile. Multiple hits in a single attack each trigger separate shuffles.
